label: Fresh exploratory M4c instrument diagnostic; no quantization comparison

generation.reasoning: no separate reasoning mode in this checkpoint
generation.stop_policy: EOS IDs from pinned source generation_config.json; no extra stop strings
generation.template_policy: pinned source tokenizer, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False then encode(add_special_tokens=False); template supplies its default system message

allocation: 12 fresh problems x A conditional, B identical conditional plus symbolic formula, C unsimplified numerical expression; one reference only
order: case order c01..c12; rotate A/B/C, B/C/A, C/A/B by case index; repeats last
retry_policy: At most one infrastructure retry per observation on later invocation, all attempts retained; no retries for returned output; 18 reserve attempts, hard global 60 including smoke/retries; no separate smoke calls
stopping: Complete all 42 observations regardless of errors; stop only on attempt/resource ceiling or unrecoverable infrastructure; retain missingness; no exclusions, reprompts, expansions or new models
scope: Only existing original Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct BF16 preparation and config; source, tokenizer, template, decoding, JSON requirement fixed

criteria.application: Apply M4b posterior absolute/relative gates to each form separately. Apply 0.02 irrelevant threshold to error against stated prior, not observed-pre drift. Likelihood-reading and pre-response gates inapplicable (no such requests). B and C measure scaffolded constructs.

analysis.strict_format: strict-probability-v1 separately; denominator all completed EOS observations
analysis.unit: 12 numerical problems, one template cluster; forms and repeats are paired dependent observations, not new scenarios
analysis.aggregation: Trial0 only, equal problems within form and type; complete mean requires all planned terms, missing losses remain null; report scoreable counts and [0,1] missing-loss bounds
analysis.types: prior type (balanced/unequal), evidence type (favors_h/favors_not_h/uninformative), and their cross; unchanged-prior baseline abs(p-target)
analysis.pairs: B-A, C-A, C-B absolute-error differences per problem and complete equal-problem means; negative means improvement
analysis.repeatability: Exact text/status equality and absolute probability difference against same case/form trial0; repeats excluded from main metrics
analysis.interpretation: Formula benefit supports explicit rule scaffolding; only numerical-expression success points toward interpretation or variable mapping; C failure leaves computation and protocol concerns; no internal mechanism identified
analysis.recommendation_rule: A passes: retain exploratory family pending fresh held-out validation. A fails and B or C passes: revise, distinguishing scaffolded constructs from conditional updating. All fail: park this family for comparison. No automatic further diagnostic/model.
